title: Console & AI

rows.v: Tracks which canon scenes are fresh / stale / pending and runs analysis bundles — the inferred layer (threads, arcs, coherence) the rails read.
Inspect the co-located nvs.db behind the panels. (Planned.)
Mount an AI to produce that analysis for you — pick a source below.
A scene is read by analysis (threads, arcs, coherence) only once you mark it canon — so drafts you’re still wrestling with don’t skew the ledgers.
Open the scene → Properties → set its phase to “canon” (it’s frontmatter — you can also write phase: canon in Source view).
You. Canon is your call about what counts as “real” in the story — the AI can create pages, but it never marks them canon for you.
No canon gate — characters / locations / items / lore are always-live reference once they exist.

sources.title: AI sources — bring your key, or connect your plan

rows.v: Paste an Anthropic API key (console.anthropic.com → API Keys, stored encrypted on this machine). NVS runs the agent itself in a chat — pay-per-token. Not keyless: NVS holds your key.
Use your Claude Pro/Max via Claude Code — run the connect command from the Agent tab. Keyless: the model runs in your agent, not NVS.

engineNote: Either way the AI calls the *same* engine tools the UI uses (read scenes, write analysis) — it can't corrupt your files; every write is validated and stamped with its producer.
